title: Cross-Platform Mobile App (Flutter & Dart)
description: Step-by-step workflow for planning, architecting, building, testing, and deploying a production-ready iOS and Android mobile app using Flutter, Clean Architecture, and modern state management.

steps.title: App Concept & Mobile Positioning
steps.goal: Define the mobile app vision, target audience, and core value proposition.
steps.expectedOutput: Target user persona, core problem statement, competitor differentiators, and target platform priorities.
steps.prompt:
I am building a cross-platform mobile app called "{{project.name}}".
The concept is: {{project.idea}}.
My experience level is {{project.experienceLevel}}.

1. Define the primary user persona (demographics, mobile habits, primary pain points).
2. Write the core job-to-be-done statement: 'When [situation], I want to [motivation], so I can [outcome]'.
3. Identify the top 3 competing apps in this space and articulate our key competitive edge.
4. Determine platform priorities: iOS, Android, and optional Web/Desktop expansion.

steps.title: MVP Screen Map & User Flows
steps.goal: Outline the minimum viable screen inventory and critical navigation paths.
steps.expectedOutput: Screen inventory (5-8 screens), primary user journeys, and explicit V1 non-goals.
steps.prompt:
For "{{project.name}}" with job-to-be-done: {{decisions.coreJobToBeDone}}

1. List the 5-8 essential screens for the MVP (e.g., Onboarding, Home Feed, Detail Screen, Form / Create Action, User Profile, Settings).
2. Map the primary happy-path flow from launch to successful core action.
3. Identify hardware device permissions needed (Camera, Location, Push Notifications, Storage, Biometrics).
4. List 5 clear V1 non-goals to prevent scope creep.

steps.title: Flutter Architecture & State Management
steps.goal: Choose state management (Riverpod / BLoC), architecture pattern, and package ecosystem.
steps.expectedOutput: Architecture blueprint (Clean Architecture / Feature-first), state management choice, and core package list.
steps.prompt:
Define the Flutter technical architecture for "{{project.name}}" targeting a {{project.experienceLevel}} developer:
1. State Management: Recommend Riverpod 2.x, Flutter BLoC, or Provider based on app complexity: {{decisions.mvpFeatures}}.
2. Architecture Pattern: Feature-first Clean Architecture (presentation, domain, data layers).
3. Backend & Cloud: Firebase, Supabase, or Custom REST/GraphQL API.
4. Recommended core dependencies: networking (Dio), routing (go_router), local storage, and dependency injection.

steps.title: Data Models & Local Persistence Strategy
steps.goal: Design domain entities, DTOs with JSON serialization, and local caching strategy.
steps.expectedOutput: Domain entity definitions, Freezed / json_serializable DTO plans, and Hive / Isar / SQLite storage strategy.
steps.prompt:
Design the data models and persistence strategy for "{{project.name}}":
1. Define Dart entity classes and JSON-serializable models for all core features: {{decisions.mvpFeatures}}.
2. Select the local persistence engine: Hive / Isar (fast NoSQL), SQLite via sqflite / drift (relational), or SharedPreferences (simple flags).
3. Define offline-first sync policy: optimistic UI updates, background synchronization, and conflict resolution.
4. Provide mock seed data for 3 test entities.

steps.title: Flutter Project Scaffolding & Analysis Rules
steps.goal: Initialize Flutter project, configure pubspec.yaml, and establish strict linting rules.
steps.expectedOutput: Terminal commands, pubspec.yaml dependencies, analysis_options.yaml lint configuration, and folder layout.
steps.prompt:
Scaffold the project structure for "{{project.name}}" using {{decisions.stateManagement}} and {{decisions.architecturePattern}}:
1. Provide the flutter create command with bundle ID and target platforms.
2. Complete pubspec.yaml with all required dependencies and dev_dependencies.
3. analysis_options.yaml with strict pedantic rules (flutter_lints + extra type-safety rules).
4. Directory layout: lib/core/, lib/features/, lib/theme/, test/.

steps.title: Design System, Material 3 Theme & Tokens
steps.goal: Implement Material 3 color schemes, dark/light themes, typography scales, and reusable UI tokens.
steps.expectedOutput: ThemeData configuration, ColorScheme tokens, responsive spacing constants, and reusable button/input styles.
steps.prompt:
Build the Material 3 design system and theme configuration for "{{project.name}}":
1. Light and Dark ThemeData with harmonious ColorScheme, custom elevated buttons, and input decoration themes.
2. Typography styles matching Google Fonts (Inter / Roboto / Poppins).
3. Spacing, padding, and border radius constant definitions (AppSpacing, AppRadius).
4. Reusable stateful theme mode switcher.

steps.title: Declarative Routing & Navigation Graph
steps.goal: Set up declarative routing using go_router with deep linking, tab shell routes, and auth redirects.
steps.expectedOutput: GoRouter configuration with ShellRoute (bottom navigation bar), auth guards, and route parameter parsing.
steps.prompt:
Implement the navigation graph for "{{project.name}}" using go_router with screens: {{decisions.screenMap}}:
1. Top-level GoRouter with initial route, error page, and auth redirect listener.
2. StatefulShellRoute.indexedStack for bottom navigation tab persistence.
3. Nested sub-routes for item detail views with typed path/query parameters.
4. Fullscreen modal routes for creation / checkout flows.
5. Deep linking URL scheme configuration for push notification navigation.

steps.title: Dio API Client, Interceptors & Error Handling
steps.goal: Build a robust HTTP network client with authentication interceptors, retry policies, and error mappers.
steps.expectedOutput: Configured Dio client, auth header interceptor with token refresh, connectivity listener, and custom Failure models.
steps.prompt:
Build the networking and API layer for "{{project.name}}" targeting {{decisions.backendStrategy}}:
1. Centralized ApiClient wrapping Dio with base URL, connect timeouts, and receive timeouts.
2. AuthInterceptor to automatically attach Bearer tokens and handle 401 token refresh queues.
3. LoggingInterceptor and PrettyDioLogger for development debugging.
4. Typed ApiException and Failure sealed class hierarchy with user-friendly error message resolution.

steps.title: Auth Flows, State & Secure Storage
steps.goal: Implement user authentication, session persistence with FlutterSecureStorage, and multi-provider login.
steps.expectedOutput: Login / Register screens, auth state notifier, secure token vault, and logout / session expiry handlers.
steps.prompt:
Implement the complete authentication module for "{{project.name}}":
1. Secure token repository using flutter_secure_storage for access and refresh tokens.
2. Auth state management using {{decisions.stateManagement}} (Initial, Unauthenticated, Authenticated, Loading, Error).
3. Login and Registration UI screens with form validation and password visibility toggles.
4. Biometric authentication helper using local_auth for returning sessions.
5. Comprehensive logout flow with cache and storage cleanup.

steps.title: Core Feature Screens & Modular Widgets
steps.goal: Build the primary business screens with responsive layouts, lists, forms, and custom animations.
steps.expectedOutput: Home screen, search with debouncing, detail views, custom cards, and pull-to-refresh list views.
steps.prompt:
Build the core screens for "{{project.name}}" matching: {{decisions.screenMap}}:
1. Main dashboard / feed screen with RefreshIndicator, paginated ListView.builder, and search bar.
2. Custom responsive card widgets with hero animations and shimmer skeleton loading states.
3. Detail screen with custom SliverAppBar, sticky headers, and bottom action bar.
4. Create/Edit form screen with reactive form inputs and image picker integration.
5. Meaningful EmptyState and ErrorRetry widgets with actionable CTA buttons.

steps.title: State Wiring, Use Cases & Repositories
steps.goal: Connect UI widgets to business logic, domain use cases, and repository data sources.
steps.expectedOutput: Complete state controllers (Riverpod AsyncNotifier / BLoC Cubits), repository implementations, and data streaming.
steps.prompt:
Wire the business logic and repository layers for "{{project.name}}" using {{decisions.stateManagement}}:
1. Domain Repository interfaces and Concrete Data Repository implementations.
2. State controllers handling AsyncValue / Bloc states (Loading, Success, Error, Empty).
3. Optimistic state updates for user interactions (likes, saves, cart, toggles).
4. Stream-based real-time data listeners where applicable.

steps.title: Offline Caching & Data Synchronization
steps.goal: Implement offline-first repository caching with local database and background synchronization.
steps.expectedOutput: Local database DAOs, cache-first network fallback strategy, and offline banner indicators.
steps.prompt:
Implement the offline caching strategy for "{{project.name}}" using {{decisions.storageEngine}}:
1. Local DAO / box storage for caching API responses.
2. Repository cache policy: return cached data immediately, then fetch from network in background (stale-while-revalidate).
3. Connectivity status listener widget displaying a non-intrusive offline indicator when disconnected.
4. Offline mutation queue to replay actions when connection is restored.

steps.title: Push Notifications, Hardware APIs & Native Channels
steps.goal: Integrate push notifications (FCM), native camera/photos, and platform-specific channels.
steps.expectedOutput: Firebase Cloud Messaging setup, local notifications handler, permission handlers, and image picker service.
steps.prompt:
Configure native device capabilities for "{{project.name}}":
1. Push Notification handler using firebase_messaging and flutter_local_notifications with foreground/background payload handlers.
2. Device permission manager using permission_handler.
3. Media picker helper for camera and gallery photo uploads.
4. Native splash screen and app icon generation config using flutter_launcher_icons and flutter_native_splash.

steps.title: Unit, Widget & Integration Testing Suite
steps.goal: Write comprehensive unit tests for business logic, mock repositories, and widget test cases.
steps.expectedOutput: Repository mock tests, StateNotifier / Cubit unit tests, key widget rendering tests, and coverage command.
steps.prompt:
Write a comprehensive testing suite for "{{project.name}}":
1. Unit tests for Repository and ApiClient using mocktail / mockito.
2. State management controller tests verifying state transitions on success and failure.
3. Widget tests testing form validation, button interactions, and loading indicator visibility.
4. Terminal command to run tests with coverage reporting (flutter test --coverage).

steps.title: 60 FPS Performance Profiling & Asset Optimization
steps.goal: Eliminate widget rebuild bottlenecks, optimize image caching, and reduce bundle sizes.
steps.expectedOutput: Performance checklist, const widget auditing, cached_network_image configuration, and tree-shaking setup.
steps.prompt:
Conduct a performance and release readiness audit for "{{project.name}}":
1. Optimize widget rebuilds using const constructors, RepaintBoundary, and selective provider listeners.
2. Image optimization: set up cached_network_image with memory disk cache limits and SVG pre-caching.
3. Memory leak prevention: audit TextEditingController, StreamSubscription, and AnimationController disposal.
4. Obfuscation and symbol splitting flags for release builds (--obfuscate --split-debug-info).

steps.title: App Store & Google Play Store Publishing Pipeline
steps.goal: Configure app signing, generate release AAB & IPA bundles, and automate CI/CD release deployment.
steps.expectedOutput: Android keystore signing guide, iOS Xcode provisioning profile setup, Fastlane / GitHub Actions release workflow.
steps.prompt:
Create the production store publishing pipeline for "{{project.name}}":
1. Android release configuration: keystore signing in android/key.properties and build.gradle for App Bundle (AAB).
2. iOS release configuration: bundle identifier, privacy manifest strings, and export options plist.
3. GitHub Actions CI/CD release workflow for building Android AAB and iOS IPA on tag pushes.
4. Store submission checklist: screenshots, metadata descriptions, privacy policy URL, and test accounts.
